title: Evaluation of a mapped CNF list
statement: Let $X$ be a list of objects, let each object $i$ determine a CNF clause $f(i)$ over variables in a set $A$, and let $a:A\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be an assignment. The conjunction of the clauses in the list obtained by applying $f$ to every element of $X$ evaluates to true if and only if every clause $f(i)$ for $i\in X$ evaluates to true.
hypotheses_covered: A function assigning a CNF clause to each object
A Boolean assignment to the variables
